name: Annotation callout
purpose: Handwritten-style note with a hand-drawn loop around a target and a curved arrow to it: the animator's or teacher's margin note, used to name what the viewer should notice.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: What the note points at (measured at the enter time)

inputs.name: distance
inputs.description: Gap between target and note in --u units

inputs.name: loop
inputs.description: Draw a hand loop around the target

implementation.api: Studio.comp.callout(parent, {text, target, side, distance, loop, seed}) -> {enter(tl, at), exit(tl, at)}

layout_notes: Positions are computed per format from the target's rendered box and clamped to the safe area; choose side per format with Studio.pick when the target sits near an edge. The parent must be a full-frame container (a scene).
validation_steps: python scripts/frame-review.py <project> --fonts google (the note must stay inside the safe area and off other text)

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test (note visible inside the safe area, loop fully drawn) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
